description: This file defines the jQuery UI Dialog widget, including its options, methods, event handling, and internal logic for creating, managing, and destroying dialog windows with features like draggable, resizable, modal overlays, and accessibility support.

classes.name: ui.dialog
classes.description: A jQuery UI widget that creates customizable dialog windows with options for modal, draggable, resizable, and accessibility features.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the dialog widget, sets up DOM structure, and applies options.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the dialog window, setting focus and positioning.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog window and triggers associated events.

methods.name: moveToTop
methods.description: Brings the dialog to the front of the z-index stack.

methods.name: _size
methods.description: Calculates and applies size constraints to the dialog.

methods.name: _position
methods.description: Positions the dialog according to the specified options.

methods.name: _createOverlay
methods.description: Creates a modal overlay behind the dialog if modal option is true.
